description: This Java interface defines an asynchronous facade for retrieving partial information about 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto framework, specifically for signal enrichment purposes. It includes method signatures for fetching parts of a thing using identifiers, field selectors, headers, and optional signals.

classes.name: SignalEnrichmentFacade
classes.description: An interface for asynchronous retrieval of parts of a 'thing' within the signal enrichment context.

methods.name: retrievePartialThing
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves specified parts of a 'thing' identified by 'thingId'. The retrieval can be customized using 'jsonFieldSelector', includes authorization via 'dittoHeaders', and optionally correlates with 'concernedSignal'. Returns a CompletionStage that completes with a JsonObject containing the requested data or fails with an error.
